motions.name: broken_1
motions.line: There'll be no problems with me protecting you!

motions.name: broken_2
motions.line: This is only temporary, Commander... Therefore...therefore, you mustn't give up!

motions.name: broken_3
motions.line: Don't... Don't worry about me! Everyone, go protect the supplies!

motions.name: broken_4
motions.line: We're back, safe and sound! I told you there was no need to worry!

motions.name: broken_5
motions.line: I will cherish this strength!

motions.name: login
motions.line: Ah, is that you, Commander? The surroundings are peaceful today, but you need to stay alert!

motions.name: login
motions.line: Ah, is that you, Commander? The surroundings are peaceful today, but you need to stay alert!

motions.name: touch_1
motions.line: I really hope these peaceful days will last forever.

motions.name: touch_2
motions.line: Commander, you seem down today! If you have anything to say then say it properly.

motions.name: touch_3
motions.line: Here's a tip.

motions.name: touch_4
motions.line: Commander, are you heading out for a mission? Come find me whenever you need help.

motions.name: touch_5
motions.line: The power of justice has multiplied once more. Commander, you should take some pride in yourself too.

motions.name: wedding
motions.line: Commander, I've known how you've felt since a long time ago.<>But it's a little embarrassing to hear you say it out like this...<>In any case, why don't we go on a walk together first?

motions.name: wedding_touch
motions.line: Commander, would you like to rest for a bit? I have some freshly picked fruits here, planted by yours truly.
